name: ingenidev Code Widget for Elementor
author: ingenidev by Bright Vortex LLC

sections.description:
ingenidev, Code Widget for Elementor adds a Widget to your Elementor menu providing a drag and drop, easy to use code snippet that automatically formats the contents as code and allows the page viewer to easily copy the code contents to his clipboard for ease of use.

Effortlessly Display and Share Code Snippets with Code Widget for Elementor

Enhance your Elementor pages with the Code Widget for Elementor, the perfect solution for displaying code snippets with clarity and ease. This plugin allows you to embed code blocks with a convenient copy-to-clipboard button, making it ideal for tutorials, documentation, and development showcases.

Why Use the Code Widget for Elementor?

Displaying code snippets in a visually appealing and user-friendly way is crucial for:
Improved Readability: Syntax highlighting makes code easier to understand.
Enhanced User Experience: The copy-to-clipboard button simplifies code sharing.
Professional Presentation: Clean and organized code displays add credibility to your content.
Educational Content: Perfect for tutorials, guides, and developer documentation.

Features of the Code Widget for Elementor Plugin:

✅ Copy-to-Clipboard Button: Enables users to easily copy code with a single click.
✅ Easy Elementor Integration: Seamlessly integrates with the Elementor page builder.
✅ Lightweight and Fast: Optimized for minimal impact on page load times.

How to Use This Plugin?

1.Install and activate the Code Widget for Elementor plugin.
2.Open your page in the Elementor editor.
3.Drag and drop the “Code Widget” onto your page.
4.Paste your code snippet into the widget
5.Customize the appearance and save your changes.

Who Should Use This Plugin?

Website owners who display code snippets on their Elementor pages.
Developers and programmers who want to showcase their code.
Bloggers and content creators who provide programming tutorials.
Educators and trainers who share code examples.

Elevate Your Code Presentation Today!

Make your code snippets stand out with the Code Widget for Elementor. Provide a user-friendly experience with easy code copying.

Privacy notices

This plugin, in itself, does not:

  • track users
  • write any user personal data to the database
  • send any data to external servers
  • make use of cookies

Our plugins

The following plugins are recommended by ingenidev :

  • AED Symbol Changer for Woocommerce By default, WooCommerce uses the currency symbol for the United Arab Emirates Dirham (AED) as “د.إ”. This plugin changes it to “AED “.
  • Cash on Delivery Shield a plugin that allows you to disable Cash on Delivery payment method for orders made by users who are not logged in.
